title: Consider replacing "outstanding rejected promises weak set" with a different setup
body:
If my understanding is correct, spec uses weak set on https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#outstanding-rejected-promises-weak-set is to avoid leak for the case that a rejected promise is never handled. And limit its size to avoid keeping too many unhandled rejected promises in the weak set.

We could use opposite logic to achieve the same effect which doesn't need a **weak** set nor limiting its size.

The proposal is something like,
1. Replace `outstanding rejected promises weak set` with `pending rejected promises set`. (now it is used for tracking the rejected promise which is unhandled and do **NOT** require firing rejectionhandled event when it is being handled.)

2. Replace step 5.2. of https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#the-hostpromiserejectiontracker-implementation with ```If settings object's pending rejected promises set contains promise, then remove promise from that set and return.```

3. Remove step 5.3 of https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#the-hostpromiserejectiontracker-implementation.

4. Add new step after step 2 of https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#notify-about-rejected-promises: ```For each promise p in list, add p to settings object's pending rejected promises set```

5. Replace step 4.1.4. of https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#notify-about-rejected-promises with ```
If p's [[PromiseIsHandled]] internal slot is false, remove p from settings object's pending rejected promises set. ```

But maybe I am missing something. Thanks.
